decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 gives an 18.1% relative gain, while the Methods summary attributes roughly 20% long-tail gains to popularity-debiased sampling; describing these magnitudes as consistent is calibrated.

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: P1 does not report a roughly 20% long-tail gain, so the specific comparison attributed to Sorensen-Nakata et al. is not established; P1 does not affirm the opposite either.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The 0.006 absolute increase from 0.085 to 0.091 is reasonably characterized as modest; this descriptive magnitude judgment does not require a statistical test.

numbers.quote: widely credited with roughly 20% relative gains in long-tail Recall@20
